name: Cloud AI Shorts Factory
steps: Gemini API: generate story, title, tags, 5-scene shot list
Gemini TTS API: generate Arabic narration audio
Pexels API: search/download portrait stock footage with attribution
FFmpeg on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runner: assemble vertical video and burn Arabic captions
YouTube Data API: upload as Private by default
GitHub Actions artifact: retain output for 7 days
cost_model: Free tiers/quotas only; stock footage montage, not generative text-to-video; no machine-local agent
